assign.layer: Spark UI, Status Store and Metrics

appendDesc.History Server and Event Logs: Also covers FsHistoryProvider (scans the log directory and builds application listings), HistoryServer and its pages, HistoryAppStatusStore, the disk and memory managers that limit how many applications are held, and HybridStore.
appendDesc.Spark UI, Status Store and Metrics: Also covers the console progress bar, thread dump and heap histogram pages, the pool pages, the HTTP security and JWS filters, CspNonce and the flame graph node.

tour.title: History server: from log directory to a rebuilt UI
tour.description: FsHistoryProvider scans the event log directory, replays logs through ReplayListenerBus into a status store, and lists the applications. HistoryServer serves those listings and, through the ApplicationCache, a SparkUI per application. HistoryServerDiskManager and HistoryServerMemoryManager bound the resources, and HybridStore keeps a store in memory while it is written to disk.
